levels.name: Unprepared
levels.description: No demonstrated ability to handle this category during disruption.

levels.name: 24 Hours
levels.description: Handle an ordinary disruption independently for about one day.

levels.name: 2 Weeks
levels.description: Operate comfortably during prolonged regional disruption.

levels.name: 30 Days
levels.description: Maintain critical household capabilities for about one month.

levels.name: Extended Resilience
levels.description: Deep redundancy, repair capability, renewable resources, advanced skills, and community systems.

quests.title: Calculate Household Water Requirements
quests.whyItMatters: Water planning starts with knowing the household's real daily need.
quests.validation: Household water requirement saved to profile.

quests.title: Store 24-Hour Drinking Water
quests.whyItMatters: A one-day reserve covers many common water disruptions.
quests.validation: Stored quantity meets or exceeds the saved 24-hour target.

quests.title: Label Household Utility Shutoffs
quests.whyItMatters: Fast shutoff access reduces damage during leaks, fire, or utility problems.
quests.validation: Water, gas if present, and electrical shutoffs are identified and photographed.

quests.title: Build 72-Hour Water Reserve
quests.whyItMatters: A three-day reserve covers the standard baseline for regional disruption.
quests.validation: Inventory shows stored potable water meeting the 72-hour target with location and rotation date.

quests.title: Establish Basic Water Purification
quests.whyItMatters: Purification extends stored water and provides redundancy when supply is uncertain.
quests.validation: Purification method is acquired, instructions are saved offline, and a practice run is recorded.

quests.title: Add Two Handheld Radios
quests.whyItMatters: Radios are useful only after they are tracked, charged, configured, and tested.
quests.validation: Two radios are inventoried with charging method and storage location.

quests.title: Configure Local Radio Channels
quests.whyItMatters: Radio ownership becomes useful only after configuration and shared channel plans.
quests.validation: Configured channel plan is documented and stored offline.

quests.title: Test Radio Communication Between Two Locations
quests.whyItMatters: A successful test proves the communication plan works in the real environment.
quests.validation: Successful contact is logged with locations, channel, time, and lesson notes.

quests.title: Build Vehicle Emergency Kit
quests.whyItMatters: A vehicle kit supports breakdowns, weather delays, evacuation, and field work.
quests.validation: Kit inventory is complete, located in vehicle, and QR tagged.

quests.title: Create Go-Bag Inventory
quests.whyItMatters: A go-bag is useful when contents are known, accessible, and maintained.
quests.validation: Go-bag has inventory, location, owner, QR tag, and maintenance schedule.

quests.title: Inspect Medical Supplies
quests.whyItMatters: Medical supplies must be present, findable, unexpired, and usable.
quests.validation: Medical kit inspection recorded with expired or missing items converted into acquisition needs.

quests.title: Record First Aid/CPR Training
quests.whyItMatters: Training should improve readiness only when it is tracked and current.
quests.validation: Course, date, expiration if any, and evidence are recorded.

quests.title: Test Generator For 30 Minutes
quests.whyItMatters: Backup power must be tested before an outage reveals failures.
quests.validation: Generator run duration, load, fuel, issues, and next maintenance due date are recorded.

quests.title: Create Critical Load List
quests.whyItMatters: Knowing critical loads prevents overloading backup systems and clarifies what power must support.
quests.validation: Critical loads list is saved with estimated watts and priority.

quests.title: Complete One-Hour Power Outage Drill
quests.whyItMatters: A short drill exposes gaps before a real outage.
quests.validation: Drill result captures success criteria, failures, lessons, and follow-up quests.

quests.title: Learn Compass Navigation Basics
quests.whyItMatters: GPS can fail; map and compass basics provide a durable fallback.
quests.validation: Compass use practice is logged with a simple route or bearing exercise.

quests.title: Run Home Fire Safety Check
quests.whyItMatters: Fire prevention and detection are foundational home resilience capabilities.
quests.validation: Smoke/CO detectors, extinguishers, exits, and hazards are checked.

quests.title: Create Document Backup Packet
quests.whyItMatters: Critical records support evacuation, insurance, recovery, and continuity.
quests.validation: Important documents are cataloged with secure physical and digital backup locations.

milestones.name: 72-Hour Ready

milestones.name: Grid Independent

milestones.name: Ready to Evacuate
